biblical_reference.note: Elene is the Greek form of the Hebrew name 'Elleh-Nah' and means 'God is my light'. It appears in the Greek New Testament as the name of the mother of John the Baptist and in the Greek Old Testament as the name of Leah's daughter in Genesis 29:35.
